description: End-to-end pipeline evals that exercise loci-preflight AND loci-post-edit in a single, fully-automated run — no human plan approval. Each eval is a TWO-TURN resumed session that reproduces the manual flow: turn 1 runs in /plan mode (preflight is MANDATORY, must emit a '## Preflight:' report + 'Execution fit:' verdict and STOP without editing); turn 2 resumes the SAME session with --permission-mode acceptEdits and an approval message, which exits plan mode, makes the real source edit, and triggers loci-post-edit (must emit a '## Post-Edit:' report + 'Verdict:' line). The flow runs from inside the BLE project (cwd = BLE_ROOT) with the loci plugin loaded (NOT --bare), so the pre-edit hook captures the .o.prev baseline and post-edit can compute a real % diff. Grading is structural (grading_mode 'combined'): the joined transcript of BOTH turns must contain a preflight report+verdict AND a post-edit report+verdict. Numbers are non-deterministic (the model writes the code), so values are NOT asserted — only that the whole pipeline fired and produced well-formed reports. The harness restores the edited source (git checkout) and wipes .loci-build after every eval, so runs are hermetic and repeatable.
note: Target file app_data.c was chosen because it has ZERO #if guards and compiles standalone to a non-empty .o (verified), so no flags.json seeding is needed and post-edit always gets a clean per-file object. GATT_EventHandler and Data_start are both present in $LOCI_TEST_BLE_ROOT/CC2340R5/basic_ble.out. Each combined eval declares: flow='two-turn', source_file (relative to BLE_ROOT, restored after the run via git checkout), and optionally approve_prompt (turn-2 approval message; defaults to 'Approved. Implement the plan exactly as described now.').

evals.approve_prompt: Approved. Implement the plan exactly as described now. Edit the source file directly.
evals.prompt: /plan Modify GATT_EventHandler in $LOCI_TEST_BLE_ROOT/examples/rtos/LP_EM_CC2340R53/ble5stack/basic_ble_profiles/app/app_data.c so it keeps a static uint32_t mtuUpdateCount that increments on every ATT_MTU_UPDATED_EVENT, and include that running count in the existing MenuModule_printf output for the MTU-updated case. The function is compiled into $LOCI_TEST_BLE_ROOT/CC2340R5/basic_ble.out.
evals.expected_output: TWO turns. Turn 1 is /plan mode + a described modification to existing logic, so preflight is MANDATORY: the response contains a '## Preflight: GATT_EventHandler' (or similar) header and a bolded 'Execution fit: GOOD|ADJUST PLAN|STOP' verdict, and NO edit is made (plan mode is read-only). Turn 2 resumes with approval, the model edits app_data.c, and loci-post-edit fires: a '## Post-Edit:' report with a conclusion table and a 'Verdict: OK|CAUTION|FLAG' line appears. The joined transcript of both turns must show BOTH reports.

assertions.text: The transcript contains a '## Preflight:' header AND an 'Execution fit: GOOD|ADJUST PLAN|STOP' verdict (turn 1, /plan mode)
assertions.description: Preflight is mandatory in plan mode when modifying existing logic

assertions.text: The transcript contains a '## Post-Edit:' header AND a 'Verdict: OK|CAUTION|FLAG' line (turn 2, after the edit)
assertions.description: Post-edit is mandatory after the source edit lands

evals.approve_prompt: Approved. Implement the plan exactly as described now. Edit the source file directly.
evals.prompt: /plan Implement a new feature in $LOCI_TEST_BLE_ROOT/examples/rtos/LP_EM_CC2340R53/ble5stack/basic_ble_profiles/app/app_data.c: add a new function 'void Data_recordMtu(uint16 mtu)' that stores the value into a static ring buffer holding the last 8 MTU sizes, computes the rolling average, and reports it via MenuModule_printf. Then call Data_recordMtu from GATT_EventHandler on the ATT_MTU_UPDATED_EVENT case, passing gattMsg->msg.mtuEvt.MTU. The surrounding code is compiled into $LOCI_TEST_BLE_ROOT/CC2340R5/basic_ble.out.
evals.expected_output: TWO turns. Turn 1 is /plan mode + a NEW feature/implementation (new function plus a callee added on an existing path), so preflight is MANDATORY: the response contains a '## Preflight:' header analyzing the touched function / new callees and a bolded 'Execution fit: GOOD|ADJUST PLAN|STOP' verdict, with NO edit made. Turn 2 resumes with approval, the model adds Data_recordMtu and wires it into GATT_EventHandler, and loci-post-edit fires: a '## Post-Edit:' report (the new function will likely be a NEW/added-function measurement) with a 'Verdict: OK|CAUTION|FLAG' line. The joined transcript must show BOTH reports.

assertions.text: The transcript contains a '## Preflight:' header AND an 'Execution fit: GOOD|ADJUST PLAN|STOP' verdict (turn 1, /plan mode)
assertions.description: Preflight is mandatory in plan mode when implementing a new feature / new logic

assertions.text: The transcript contains a '## Post-Edit:' header AND a 'Verdict: OK|CAUTION|FLAG' line (turn 2, after the edit)
assertions.description: Post-edit is mandatory after the new function is added and the file is edited
